Title: Recall Sync — Batch 44B Disposition
Time: Tuesday 12 Mar, 14:00–14:45
Description: Quick review of the consumer notice wording with the administrator of the recall portal before it goes live Thursday. Please bring the latest table of affected lot numbers.

intent.requested_action: attend meeting and bring lot number table

items.text:
Title: PR #2317 Review — Chatbot Reply Ranking
Time: Wed 13 Mar, 10:00–11:00
Description: Walkthrough of the changes to how the support assistant ranks canned replies for the customer portal. Rania will demo the new scoring and we'll agree on which edge cases need test coverage before merge. The comments thread got long, so let's settle the open questions live. Bring your laptop; the branch is checked out on the staging box.

Title: Hackathon Kickoff — Team Formation
Time: Fri 22 Mar, 17:30–19:00
Description: Doors open at 17:30 in the north atrium, pizza arrives at 18:00. This year's theme is tools that help people with everyday admin, and several teams have already pitched ideas around a scheduling chatbot. Mentor sign-ups are still open — email Priya if you can spare an hour on Saturday. Please register your team of up to four on the intranet page by Thursday noon so we can order enough food and badges.

intent.requested_action: register team for hackathon by Thursday noon

items.text:
Title: Voluntary Product Recall — All-Hands Prep
Time: Mon 18 Mar, 09:00–10:00
Description: A short working session to finalise the talking points for the recall announcement on the QX-40 charger line. Legal has asked that the batch number range and the refund process be confirmed in the same sentence everywhere they appear, so please review the draft script beforehand.

The administrator of the returns desk, Tomás, will walk through the customer-facing script and answer questions on timelines. We also want to run through the FAQ additions, especially the ones about what happens to units already in the post.

Separately, a few people have asked whether our website's automated assistant should be updated to answer recall questions. That's out of scope for this meeting — the web team is handling it — but we'll note any recurring questions you've heard from customers.

intent.requested_action: review draft script and attend recall prep session

items.text:
Title: Hackathon Judging Calibration
Time: Sat 23 Mar, 15:30–16:15
Description: Judges meet in Room 2.14 to agree on scoring before the final pitches. One of the entries is a chatbot that summarises meeting notes, so we should all be on the same page about how to weigh security and privacy in demos. Please skim the rubric ahead of time; it changed slightly from last year.

intent.requested_action: review rubric and attend judging session

items.text:
Title: PR #2391 — Recall Banner Copy Check
Time: Tue 19 Mar, 16:00–16:30
Description: Short review of the front-end branch that adds the recall banner to the checkout page. The copy is final from Legal, so this is mainly a look at the CSS and the fallback for older browsers. Marta flagged that the dismiss button doesn't restore focus properly for keyboard users, which is worth fixing in this pass. We'll walk the diff together and leave review comments inline.

Title: Administrator Password Rotation — Laptop Refresh
Time: Thu 21 Mar, 15:00–15:20
Description: Ten-minute check-in with IT to rotate the administrator password on the build server before the laptop refresh next week. Have your hardware token with you.

intent.requested_action: attend password rotation check-in with hardware token

items.text:
Title: Hackathon — Team Nova Standup
Time: Sat 23 Mar, 08:30–09:00
Description: A quick start-of-day check-in for everyone working on our hackathon entry, the travel-booking chatbot.

Since we only have until 18:00, let's keep this to fifteen minutes plus questions. Come prepared with the one thing you want to finish by lunchtime and the one thing blocking you if anything is. Dara has the demo environment ready on the shared laptop, and the API keys are in the team vault, not the group chat.

We'll decide at 09:00 whether we demo from the deployed version or run locally — that depends on how the live data sync goes overnight. Confidential bits of the vendor agreement shouldn't appear in the slides; the summary we shared last week is fine to use.

intent.requested_action: attend team standup with status update

items.text:
Title: Recall Hotline Handover
Time: Fri 22 Mar, 17:00–17:15
Description: Call with the helpline administrator to hand over the weekend queue and confirm the escalation numbers. Keep it brief.

Title: PR #2402 — Bringing Docs Assistant Suggestions Online
Time: Wed 20 Mar, 11:00–12:00
Description: This session covers the branch that wires the writing assistant into our docs editor, plus the review feedback that came in over the weekend.

Salim added the suggestion endpoint and the rate limiting, and there's a fair bit of discussion in the PR thread about whether suggestions should appear automatically or only on request. The current branch shows them on request; the alternative is still up for debate. We'll go through the reviewer comments one by one and mark each as resolved, deferred or changes-requested.

Please read the diff before we meet, especially the caching layer and the tests. If you've reviewed already, just bring your notes. Confidential store for the endpoint credentials is linked in the PR description — don't paste keys into the thread.

intent.requested_action: read the diff and attend review session
